questions.stem: Which of the following is the nearest star to Earth?
questions.solution: The Sun is the nearest star to Earth because it is part of our solar system and located much closer than any other star. The Moon is a natural satellite, not a star, and Pluto is a dwarf planet. Alpha Centauri is the closest star system to the Sun but is still much farther from Earth than the Sun.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन पृथ्वी के सबसे निकट का तारा है?
hi.solution: सूर्य पृथ्वी के सबसे निकट का तारा है क्योंकि यह हमारे सौर मंडल का हिस्सा है और किसी अन्य तारे की तुलना में बहुत करीब स्थित है। चंद्रमा एक प्राकृतिक उपग्रह है, तारा नहीं है, और प्लूटो एक बौना ग्रह है। एल्फा सेंटौरी सूर्य के सबसे करीब के तारा प्रणाली है लेकिन यह पृथ्वी से सूर्य की तुलना में बहुत दूर है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi scientific terminology.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी भूमीच्या जवळचा तारा कोणता आहे?
mr.solution: सूर्य भूमीच्या जवळचा तारा आहे कारण तो आपल्या सौरप्रणालीचा भाग आहे आणि इतर कोणत्याही ताऱ्यापेक्षा खूप जवळ आहे. चंद्र हा प्राकृतिक उपग्रह आहे, तारा नाही. प्लूटो हा एक बौना ग्रह आहे. अल्फा सेंटॉरी सूर्याच्या जवळच्या ताऱ्याच्या प्रणालीला जवळ आहे परंतु भूमीपेक्षा सूर्यापेक्षा खूप दूर आहे.

questions.stem: What is the main source of energy in the Sun?
questions.solution: The main source of energy in the Sun is the fusion of hydrogen nuclei, which combines to form helium and releases a large amount of energy. Fission of helium nuclei is incorrect because helium is a product, not a fuel, in the Sun's energy process. Combustion of carbon and nuclear reactions involving oxygen are not part of the Sun's energy generation mechanism.

hi.stem: सूर्य में ऊर्जा का मुख्य स्रोत क्या है?
hi.solution: सूर्य में ऊर्जा का मुख्य स्रोत हाइड्रोजन नाभिक का संलयन है, जो हीलियम बनाता है और बड़ी मात्रा में ऊर्जा उत्पन्न करता है। हीलियम नाभिक का विखंडन गलत है क्योंकि हीलियम सूर्य की ऊर्जा प्रक्रिया में ईंधन के बजाय उत्पाद है। कार्बन का दहन और ऑक्सीजन के साथ परमाणु प्रतिक्रिया सूर्य की ऊर्जा उत्पादन विधि में शामिल नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate, technical terms match Indian curriculum usage, and the structure mirrors the original.

mr.stem: सूर्यातील ऊर्जेचा मुख्य स्रोत कोणता आहे?
mr.solution: सूर्यातील ऊर्जेचा मुख्य स्रोत हायड्रोजन न्यूक्लियसचे संलयन आहे, जे हेलियम बनवते आणि मोठ्या प्रमाणात ऊर्जा बाहेर काढते. हेलियम न्यूक्लियसचे विभाजन अयोग्य आहे कारण हेलियम सूर्याच्या ऊर्जा प्रक्रियेत एक उत्पादन आहे, न की ईंधन. कार्बनचे ज्वलन आणि ऑक्सीजनसह न्यूक्लियर अभिक्रिया सूर्याच्या ऊर्जा उत्पादन विधीच्या भागात नाहीत.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the scientific terminology used in Marathi textbooks, and preserves the logical structure of the question and solution.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the end stage of the Sun?
questions.solution: The Sun, being a medium-mass star, will shed its outer layers and leave behind a dense core known as a white dwarf. Black holes form from stars much more massive than the Sun, and neutron stars are the remnants of even more massive stars. Supergiants are not the end stage of the Sun but are part of the life cycle of heavier stars. Therefore, the correct answer is that the Sun becomes a white dwarf.

hi.solution: सूर्य, एक मध्यम द्रव्यमान तारा होने के कारण, अपनी बाहरी परतों को छोड़ देगा और एक घने कोर के रूप में जाना जाने वाला सफेद बौना छोड़ देगा। कृष्ण छिद्र सूर्य से बहुत अधिक द्रव्यमान वाले तारों से बनते हैं, और न्यूट्रॉन तारे अधिक द्रव्यमान वाले तारों के अवशेष होते हैं। सुपरजियांट सूर्य के अंतिम चरण नहीं होते हैं, बल्कि भारी तारों के जीवन चक्र के हिस्से होते हैं। इसलिए, सही उत्तर यह है कि सूर्य एक सफेद बौना बन जाता है।

questions.stem: If a star runs out of hydrogen, what happens next in its life cycle?
questions.solution: When a star runs out of hydrogen, it begins to fuse helium in its core, causing the outer layers to expand and cool, which makes the star appear red and much larger—this is known as a red giant. A black hole is formed only in the final stages of very massive stars, not immediately after hydrogen depletion. Planets and moons are not formed from the life cycle of a star itself.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the end stages of low-mass stars?
questions.solution: Low-mass stars end their life as white dwarfs. This is because when they exhaust their fuel, their outer layers are expelled, and the core contracts to a small, dense state. The other options are incorrect because black holes and neutron stars are the end stages of high-mass stars, and supernovae are explosions that occur in high-mass stars.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of a neutron star?
questions.solution: A neutron star is formed from the remnants of a massive star after a supernova explosion, and it is composed mostly of neutrons, resulting in an extremely high density. Very low temperature, very large size, and very slow rotation do not align with the known properties of neutron stars, which are typically small, extremely dense, and rotate rapidly.

hi.solution: एक न्यूट्रॉन तारा एक भारी तारे के अवशेष से बनता है जो सुपरनोवा विस्फोट के बाद रह जाता है, और इसका अधिकांश भाग न्यूट्रॉन से बना होता है, जिसके कारण इसका अत्यधिक घनत्व होता है। अत्यल्प तापमान, अत्यधिक आकार और अत्यल्प घूर्णन न्यूट्रॉन तारों के ज्ञात गुणों के अनुरूप नहीं हैं, जो आमतौर पर छोटे, अत्यधिक घने और तेजी से घूर्णन करते हैं।

questions.stem: If the Sun were to lose its balance between gravitational force and gas pressure, what would most likely happen?
choices: It would become a white dwarf
It would become a black hole
It would expand into a red giant
It would shrink into a neutron star
questions.solution: If the Sun lost its balance between gravitational force and gas pressure, it would no longer be able to maintain its current size and structure. This imbalance would cause the Sun to expand as the internal pressure can no longer counteract gravity, leading to it becoming a red giant. Other options, like becoming a white dwarf, black hole, or neutron star, involve different processes that occur at later stages of stellar evolution or under different conditions.

questions.stem: If a star with a mass of 30 times the Sun explodes as a supernova, what will happen to the remaining core?
choices: It will become a white dwarf
It will become a neutron star
It will collapse into a black hole
questions.solution: A star with a mass 30 times that of the Sun will have a core that is too massive to be supported by neutron degeneracy pressure after a supernova explosion. This causes the core to collapse under its own gravity, forming a black hole. A white dwarf is formed from less massive stars, a neutron star from intermediate masses, and continued expansion is not possible due to the intense gravitational forces.

questions.stem: Why does the Sun remain stable over billions of years?
choices: Because it is the only star in the galaxy
Because the gravitational force and gas pressure are balanced
Because it is not affected by external forces
questions.solution: The Sun remains stable because the gravitational force pulling it inward is balanced by the gas pressure pushing outward. This balance prevents the Sun from collapsing or expanding. The other options are incorrect because the Sun's mass does change slightly over time, it is not the only star in the galaxy, and it is influenced by external forces, but these do not disrupt the internal balance.

questions.solution: A white dwarf remains stable because the pressure due to electrons is independent of temperature, which allows it to balance gravitational force even as its temperature decreases. The other options are incorrect because no fuel means the star has finished its life, mass is not the main reason for stability, and equilibrium is only maintained if the pressure is independent of temperature.
